title: Lightly Toasted Mediterranean Corn Flatbread
description: A peppery and molten Mediterranean dish featuring white cornmeal, perfect for a brunch mood, this flatbread is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for all tastes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, salt, and black pepper.
Add the crumbly feta cheese, chopped kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, and sun-dried tomatoes to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and lemon zest.
Gradually add the olive oil to the bowl and mix until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Roll the dough out into a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
